scope_reuse_reason: CI verifies that Minecraft 1.10's asset index id 1.10 / SHA-1 7c2800b458376b8fc0b738382fb7784328fddda9 exposes exactly the same language-code set as the audited Minecraft 1.9 asset index. Therefore the frozen 70-language project scope carries forward unchanged.
addon_full_locales_source: Use the exact addon_full_locales array from upstream/minecraft-1.9-language-scope.json.

norwegian_policy.action: Keep no_NO as the Minecraft-facing full addon locale. Preserve JEI's nb_NO upstream file and do not treat it as an alias.

upstream_supplement_policy.semantic_reversion_rule: If an addon-owned missing key has reverted to an earlier validated English meaning, restore that earlier generation's translation rather than retaining the later semantic variant.
upstream_supplement_policy.notes: Filtering G4 supplements to the 1.10 target automatically removes the deleted hideLaggyModels entries. ko_KR gui.jei.category.craftingTable is then restored from G3 (제작대). ru_RU is reduced to the two color-search keys; fr_FR and zh_CN each retain only jei.tooltip.cheat.mode.
